about: WI-12 capability catalog (GDN-046, GDN-110): what this build may claim, each claim with the recorded evidence behind it. Store text and in-app help must not claim more. CapabilityCatalogTest checks every entry: evidence files exist (a 'jvm-test' or 'emulator-test' is a test source with @Test; a 'device-record' is a filled result under dev-docs/evidence/ containing 'Outcome: PASS'); profiles match the packaged rules/profiles/ files by id, version and hash; a provisional profile is never 'release', and a 'release' profile cites a signed decision under dev-docs/decisions/ naming its exact id, version and hash; Bluetooth and iPhone need a device record before they may be listed. 'notYetEvidenced' names the procedures still owed; nothing in it may be claimed.

unsupported: Signed by the project owner alone (2026-10-16), checked against the abridged 2022 trial text only; the printed 2017 and 2022 rule books were not checked and no Guandan rules reviewer signed (dev-docs/decisions/G1a-base-rules.md).
bomb.maxSize depends on D2, left as the stated default (9- and 10-card bombs legal) and still pending a full-edition source check.
D11 (whether the reposted national texts are faithful) is left as the stated default.
Only base-v1 is offered; no other regional or house variant is supported.
Custom profiles and timed formats are not supported (M2, WI-13).

Signed by the project owner alone (2026-10-16), checked against the abridged 2022 trial text only; no Guandan rules reviewer signed the decisions D25-D40 or the fixture list (dev-docs/decisions/G1b-match-profile.md).

Every decision D25-D40 of rules/match-v1.md is adopted at its stated default (tribute, return, resistance, opening lead, level gains, passing-A failure counting, card-count reporting, early double-up settlement).
Only match-v1 is offered; no published event rule document has been adopted as the match profile.
Custom profiles and timed formats are not supported (M2, WI-13).

transports.claim: Solo play against three AI seats in one process, with no network, discovery or radio (GDN-005).
notYetEvidenced: HP-1: a full solo match on a physical phone in airplane mode with Bluetooth and Wi-Fi off.

transports.claim: Rooms on the same Wi-Fi network over TCP with NSD discovery, verified over loopback sockets on one device and in one JVM; not yet between phones.
notYetEvidenced: HP-2: four phones plus two spectators over LAN, full match (no capacity or multi-device claim).
NsdRoomDirectory (Android discovery) has no automated test.

platforms.claim: Android app; automated tests ran on the JVM and on an API 36 emulator only.
notYetEvidenced: G5: no supported device matrix is signed; no physical phone and no Android version below 36 has been tested.

ai.claim: Offline baseline AI; zero illegal actions in the gate corpus; measured only against a random-legal opponent (not against people).
notYetEvidenced: p95 decision time on the named minimum Android device.

omissions.reason: No device record: the G5 device spike and HP-3 have not been run (dev-docs/ble-device-spike.md). The bleTransport flag is off by default.

Gate G3 decided a native Swift core (dev-docs/decisions/G3-iphone-architecture.md), but only a package skeleton exists (ios/GuandanCore); the rules engine is not ported and no iPhone has run anything (WI-11).
